## Grants

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

render_grant <- function(g) {
  labels <- c(
    "**PI:**", "**Sponsor:**", "**Funding Organization:**",
    "**Amount Awarded:**", "**Period of Grant Award:**", "**Title:**"
  )
  values <- c(
    g$PI, g$Sponsor, g$Funding_Org,
    if (!is.na(g$Amount) && nzchar(trimws(g$Amount))) paste0("\\$", g$Amount) else NA,
    g$Period, g$Project_Title
  )

  keep <- !is.na(values) & nzchar(trimws(values))
  lines <- sprintf("%s %s", labels[keep], values[keep])

  cat(sprintf("*%s*\\\n", g$Grant_Name))
  cat(paste(lines, collapse = "\\\n"))
  cat("\n\n")
}

for (status in c("Current", "Completed")) {
  section <- grants |> filter(Status == status)
  if (nrow(section) > 0) {
    cat(sprintf("### [%s Research]{.underline}\n\n", status))
    for (i in seq_len(nrow(section))) render_grant(section[i, ])
  }
}
```

## Awards

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

render_entry <- function(a) {
  cat(sprintf("-   **%s** \\| *%s*\n\n", a$Title, a$Organization))
  if (!is.na(a$Description) && nzchar(trimws(a$Description))) {
    cat(sprintf("    -   %s\n\n", a$Description))
  }
}

awards <- awards_honors |> filter(Category == "Award") |> arrange(desc(Year))
for (yr in sort(unique(awards$Year), decreasing = TRUE)) {
  cat(sprintf("### %s\n\n", yr))
  yr_entries <- awards |> filter(Year == yr)
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(yr_entries))) render_entry(yr_entries[i, ])
}
```

## Honors

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis

honors <- awards_honors |> filter(Category == "Honor") |> arrange(desc(Year))
for (yr in sort(unique(honors$Year), decreasing = TRUE)) {
  cat(sprintf("### %s\n\n", yr))
  yr_entries <- honors |> filter(Year == yr)
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(yr_entries))) render_entry(yr_entries[i, ])
}
```
